# Assimilation Memorandum: Ant Design (antd v6.6.3)
**Source:** https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design  
**Assimilated By:** Antigravity / MERLIN_OMEGA / LADY_GUINEVERE  
**Target Subsystems:** apps/pwa, Lady Guinevere (Aesthetic Harmony), Sir Stitch (Kinematics & Micro-interactions)

## Architectural Profile
- **Release Line:** Ant Design v6.6.3 (TypeScript strict, Biome format/lint, CSS-in-JS + @layer styling)
- **Core Capabilities:**
  - Token-based design architecture (Design Tokens, Component Tokens, Seed/Map/Alias tokens)
  - Full-featured enterprise widgets: Data Table (virtualized sorting, filtering, row selection), Form & Form.Item reactive validation, TreeSelect, DatePicker, Cascader
  - Accessibility & multi-language i18n support across 50+ locales

## Camelot Sovereign Governance Alignment
- **Rule 1 Enforcement:** CAMELOT-OS mandates Tailwind v4 and Luxora Gold (`#D4AF37`) for primary highlights. Direct monolithic runtime imports of `@ant-design/cssinjs` are rejected in the hot-path to preserve sub-100ms FCP and green compute budgets.
- **Architectural Extraction:**
  1. Component API contract patterns (declarative schema-driven forms, structured tables).
  2. Design token mapping algorithm mapped to Tailwind v4 CSS variables.
  3. Micro-interaction and kinematic states assigned to Sir Stitch (`0fdccdc1-a1d2-48c2-8948-187398bfbeb5`).
